name: nexus_reorder_item
description:
Reorder reorderable items (collection images/videos) via v2 GraphQL.

Requires ownership of the parent collection.

Returns:
    JSON {item: {__typename}} or an error string.

id.description: ID of the item (collection image/video) to move.
id.title: Id

target_id.description: ID of the item to position relative to.
target_id.title: Target Id
